domain: authz/config / Cedar deploy parity / Helm ConfigMaps

facets.F1_correctness: Deletes the unused oya/analytics Helm Cedar ConfigMap template that carried the legacy action-agnostic blanket permit, removes its baseline grandfather entry, and removes the now-unused chart cedar values block.
facets.F2_tests: Added authz_004_dead_configmaps_are_deleted_from_blanket_baseline; RED failed while oya/analytics remained in baseline, GREEN passed after deletion and baseline shrink.
facets.F3_maintainability: Keeps the slice to one chart/capability and records the shrink in ADR-0608, the policy DATA reason, and the changelog.
facets.F4_compatibility: No Rust public API, Cargo dependency, Buck target, workflow, or generated JSON face is hand-edited. The analytics Deployment did not mount the Cedar ConfigMap, so removing the template avoids a runtime mount change.
facets.F5_security: Removes an executable deployed blanket permit surface instead of leaving it protected only by a shrink-only grandfather baseline.
facets.F6_privacy: Prevents the deleted blanket from authorizing tenant-class-wide analytics resource access in any future chart deployment path.
facets.F7_operability: Baseline count shrinks from 68 to 67 and the live cedar-deploy-parity scan stays green; helm rendering could not be run locally because helm is not installed.
facets.F8_performance: Slightly reduces the live ConfigMap scan set by one file; no runtime hot path is added.
facets.F9_compliance: No hand-edited *.generated.json file. ADR-0608 and docs/CHANGELOG.md record the policy/security rationale.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert restoring the analytics cedar template, values block, and baseline entry.
facets.F11_observability: The cloud-ci-cedar-deploy-parity gate remains the observable enforcement surface; the new regression exposes accidental reintroduction.
facets.F13_migration: This is the first product-surface baseline shrink after the GH #987 Cloud slice, using deletion for a dead/unmounted chart ConfigMap rather than policy replacement for a live mount.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Chose delete over disarm because the chart Deployment has no volume/env/mount reference to the Cedar ConfigMap, so preserving an unused policy resource would keep risk without serving live traffic.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: Advances the AUTHZ-004 one-chart-at-a-time baseline shrink without touching shared authz runtime, generated faces, or other product-surface charts.

scope.summary: Delete the dead oya/analytics blanket Cedar Helm ConfigMap and shrink the cedar-deploy-parity baseline by one.
